text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
One day, while fighting monsters out on the plains,
{0} hears a sudden loud cry right beside him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ある日、{0}が平原で魔物と戦っていると、
横から大きな声が聞こえてきた。

text_block_list.text: Hyaaahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: てええええい！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Graaarghhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.text:
All right! Downed with one strike!
And that's that quest complete! On to the next!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よしっ！　
一撃必殺ね！
討伐依頼達成！　
次っ！

text_block_list.text: *huff, huff...* *huff, huff...*
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふっ、ふっ、
ふっ、ふっ……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Grrrghhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
A short while later in another location,
{0} finds himself locked in combat with monsters when—
text_block_list.orig_text:
それからまた少しして、別の場所で
{0}が魔物と死闘を繰り広げていると──

text_block_list.text: Hyaaahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: でえええええい！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Graaarghhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.text: All right! Downed with one strike!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よしっ！　
一撃必殺！

text_block_list.text:
Hmm. My movements weren't quite optimal there, though.
I'll have to work on that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん……
でも
今の動き方には少し無駄があったわね。
反省、
反省……

text_block_list.text: Huh? Say...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
あれ……

text_block_list.text:
Hey, you. I keep seeing you around...
Are you a bounty hunter? Or maybe a bodyguard?
choice_data_list: I'm not sure what you're talking about.
I'm just a knight passing by this way.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねえ、キミ。
さっきからよく会うけど……
キミは賞金稼ぎ？　
それとも用心棒？

text_block_list.text: So I guess we aren't in the same line of work, huh.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうやら同業者ではなさそう、
か……

text_block_list.text: Hmm. Well, that could work.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふうん。
まあいいけど。

text_block_list.text: By the way, what's your name?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ところでキミ、
名前はなんて言うの？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Ahh. {0}, eh? My name's Mifuyu.
Pleased to meet you. I'm a mercenary from the Mercurius
Foundation, so I'll conquer any quest... for the right price!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう。
{0}ね。
私の名前はミフユよ。
以後お見知りおきを。
メルクリウス財団に所属してる……
報酬次第でなんでもこなす、
傭兵よ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I also handle all kinds of odd jobs at an hourly rate!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしくは、
どこででも時給で働く敏腕アルバイトよ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
By the way, we need to talk about your swordplay.
It's so sloppy I could barely stand to watch.
What do you think is most important when it comes to combat?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ところで、
さっきのキミの剣さばき。
もたもたしてて見てられなかったわ。
キミは、戦いに一番必要なものって
なんだと思う？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Mm, winning isn't the only thing that matters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
ただ勝つだけじゃだめ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Close... but not quite.
text_block_list.orig_text:
近いけど……
惜しいわね。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: The correct answer is... \"efficiency\"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
正解は……
『効率』よ！！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Minimal movement, maximum efficiency. That, my friend, is what makes
the ultimate mercenary. Time is money! And time waits for no one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
最短の動きで最高の効率を得る。
それこそが、
私の目指す
最強の傭兵。
時は金なり！　
時間は待ってくれないの！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
In other words, if you've got the time to soak in a success
after a leisurely monster battle, you might as well move
more efficiently to take out another one.
text_block_list.orig_text:
つまり、
のんびり敵を一匹倒して余韻に浸る暇があったら、
もっと効率的に動いて、
もう一匹倒すわけ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Do you have a moment? I'll show you how it's done.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと見ててくれる？　
実演して見せるから。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
So if you want to take down two foes in one go,
first you hit 'em hard like this, then spin around and... There!
text_block_list.orig_text:
敵を一撃で二匹倒すには……
最初ドーンといって、
グイッと来て、
こう！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Heheh, that's how it's done!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふん、
ざっとこんな感じよ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hold on. I just had an idea for an even more efficient way
of doing things! Maybe if I start from here and then go
like this and this, I can add in a third hit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
待って……？　
もっと効率的な倒し方を思いついたわ！
もしかしたら、
こう振りかぶった後に、
こうやってこうしたら
三撃目を当てることが……！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: ...Urkkk...
choice_data_list: Um... Did you hurt your back?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: ...No, I'm fine.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……痛めてないわ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I-I said I'm fine! Really!
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
痛めてないってば！！　
ほんとよ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, those attacks of yours—they've got decent force
behind them. Your swordplay's a little iffy, but with the right training,
I think you have the makings of a great warrior.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
キミのあの攻撃。
なかなか威力はあったように見えたわ。
剣さばきはおぼつかないものの、
きちんと鍛えれば
結構な戦力になると思うのよ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I have an idea! How about I take you under my wing?
I'll teach you everything you need to know about
efficient fighting!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ。
キミ、
私の弟子になってみない？
効率的な倒し方を、
手取り足取り教えてあげるわよ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, heheheh. No need to thank me.
From now on, you and I will have regular training sessions
here in this field! Like this, and this—
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいえ。
ふふふ、
礼には及ばないわ。
これから、定期的にこの平原でキミを
しごいてあげるからね！　
こうやって、
こう……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Urk! Owieee... My back...
choice_data_list: (I'll just pretend I didn't see that.)
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あたた……
腰が……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
By the way, I'll cut you a massive deal on my instructor fees.
Only 750 rupies per hour!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ところで、
教官料はおお負けに負けて、
時給７５０ルピでいいわよ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's the matter? You look absolutely floored.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……？　
どうしたの、
狐につままれたみたいな顔をして？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
\"Adopted\" as a student and then charged for it,
{0} was left in awe of the tenacity
of Mifuyu's entrepreneurial spirit...
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分から弟子をとって、謝礼を要求していく
ミフユの商魂たくましさに驚愕する{0}であった……
